new_result.statement: For a 3D orthogonal product projection Y=U^T X whose physical row leverages c_i=||u_i||^2 are all <=1/2, sharp Hausdorff-Young plus geometric Brascamp-Lieb gives ||hat p_Y||_1 <= (2*pi)^3 e^(3/2). Hence for every invertible symmetric 3x3 M and arbitrary affine term, Y^T M Y+beta^T Y+gamma has a continuous density bounded by 3e |det M|^(-1/3).
new_result.conditional_residual_extension: After conditioning any ORIGINAL coordinate set S, if G=U_R^T U_R>0 and all normalized residual leverages u_i^T G^(-1)u_i <=1/2, then ||p_Q||_infinity <=3e [|det M| det G]^(-1/3), with continuity.
new_result.one_hub_application: For one physical hub of leverage h<1, det G=1-h, so the residual-diffuse branch obeys ||p_Q||_infinity <=3e [D(1-h)]^(-1/3). In particular D(1-h)>=1/64 gives <12e<32.620.

compatibility_note: The live PHASE-WIENER universal-false correction is not contradicted: its A=I_3 example has row leverage 1, outside the <=1/2 hypothesis. The new result uses original-product Fourier factorization and never claims post-rotation independence.
